problem_statement: net_ipaddr_parse() overflows its internal buffer when parsing an IP address string that also carries a port number with an overly long port field. For example, parsing "192.0.2.1:" followed by many digits, or "[::1]:" followed by many characters, or a valid ip:port string passed with a str_len much larger than the actual content, causes the port substring to be copied past a fixed-size local buffer and written out of bounds. Such inputs must be rejected without memory corruption, and valid ip:port strings with an oversized str_len must still be parsed correctly (correct address and port).
twister_command: scripts/twister -p native_sim/native/64 -T tests/net/utils -s tests/net/utils/net.util.asan -s net.util.asan -O twister-out --no-clean -W
